name: Broodcaller Scourge
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to a player, you may put a permanent card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to a player, you may put a permanent card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.

needs.what: A binding on the `creatures_deal_combat_damage` trigger (with `per_player` and a Dragon `filter`) carrying the total combat damage the matching creatures dealt to that player, so "mana value less than or equal to that damage" can be a `mana_value` selector `{"op": "<=", "value": {"binding": "damage_dealt"}}` on a `put_onto_battlefield` from hand
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The CREATURES_DEALT_COMBAT_DAMAGE event fired by combat._fire_damage_batch carries only `damagers`, `damaged`, `damaged_battles` and `hits` (oids per seat), never an amount, so the trigger's `amount`/`damage` bindings are absent; `deals_combat_damage_to_player` carries a per-creature amount but fires once per creature, not once for 'one or more Dragons' with their summed damage; no value key (`damage_taken_this_turn`, `max_damage_taken_this_turn`) isolates this combat's damage from the filtered creatures
